title: Seesaw: gentle tip
prompt: One isolated illustrated object on a perfectly flat solid bright magenta background. Locked camera. Polished painted 2D storybook illustration. Preserve the exact object in the input image. 0-0.3s: rest. 0.3-1.1s: The triangular pedestal and center pivot stay fixed. The single connected seesaw plank slowly tips with its left end slightly up and right end down, then returns toward level. Keep the seats and handles attached to the same rigid plank. No characters, no bending plank. 1.1-1.4s: settle. Background remains solid magenta. No zoom, no scene, no text, no shadow on the background, no style change. Sound: silence.
method: Nondestructive source RGBA isolation and whole-cell normalization; original unchanged.
